cases.before: Pinned native edit_file lost one distinct same-file edit in 50/50 trials; shared-registry delegate_task replay lost 29/30.
cases.after: Local per-file guarded edit_file preserved both in 50/50 native trials and 30/30 delegated-registry replays; disjoint-file control 50/50.
cases.comparability: Same Kram commit, native Go tool and fixed concurrent source workloads. Delegated calls use a synthetic task selector, not a model; 50-trial and 30-trial results are local observations. Independent blind selection is potentially contaminated by prior session context.
cases.next_gate: Cross-agent/model workload and first-party review, exact-stage authorization, then human-owned external contribution; no S2 regrade.

cases.before: Controlled two-worker shared-file schedule: 1/2 intended updates preserved; both reported done, no conflict feedback.
cases.after: Opt-in file-scope wrapper: 2/2 updates preserved after explicit retry; 1 conflicting admission refused; disjoint declared workers remained concurrent.
cases.comparability: Same pinned Zot source and deterministic synthetic runners, but explicit retry changes the schedule and throughput.
cases.next_gate: First-party demand, compatibility with long-lived Zot sessions, and authoritative file-write scope.

cases.before: Native CLI preflight/assignment accepted T-1, T-2 and T-3 as three separate box allocation requests against a stubbed Hub API.
cases.after: Opt-in planner recommended [T-1,T-2] and [T-3] using explicitly supplied write intent; 20/20 new native Vitest checks passed.
cases.comparability: Paired task intent at source/planner level; no boxes, real file modifications or user-facing conflict frequency measured.
cases.next_gate: Human-owned issue-first AgentBox Phase 4 design feedback, then real conflicting/disjoint box workloads.

cases.before: Original compiled kit sessions failed to start with issue #222 partial TOML (missing subagent.harness).
cases.after: Compiled patched CLI exited successfully, warned about subagent.harness, and preserved the TOML bytes; original/added Rust tests passed.
cases.comparability: Same pinned Kit source and issue-level CLI fixture; no model session or deployment measured.
cases.next_gate: Internal fallback-policy review and human-owned Kit contribution; never count as Index-derived discovery.

cases.before: First-party issue #524 requested an independent review role; no controlled live-model review-quality baseline recorded.
cases.after: Native reviewer role, process/permission boundaries and JSONL parsing tested; model precision/recall still unmeasured.
cases.comparability: Tests prove source contracts, not a before/after reviewer-quality metric.
cases.next_gate: External publication decision and real-model paired quality study if the effectiveness claim is needed.

cases.before: First-party issue #1772 reports second-host socket takeover; original gateway source unlinks the socket without host ownership.
cases.after: V2 gateway-ownership patch passed source-pinned native gateway regressions and full check:push; no deployed end-user result measured.
cases.comparability: Pinned-source regression tests; production multi-host deployment not observed.
cases.next_gate: Exact-stage contribution authorization, native external review and deployed host observation.
